Dream 2026-11-22 suggests a refinement: broaden.

**What the vignettes add.** The loss is not only the exploration material but the process itself: doubts, questions, failures and discoveries (73ae8761, 1cf3ef4f). The owner starts an essay by creating the bigger container (29094aed) and wants explorations kept in their own container (f15bd5f6).

**Proposed.** When I write an essay I start by creating the bigger container, and I need it to hold the whole process: the conversations, sources, doubts, questions, failures and discoveries, not just the finished product. Today that rough work scatters across chats and the fields of the claims it produced, so I cannot return to the thinking that built my understanding.

**Depth.** Four vignettes, 2026-10-24 to 2026-11-06, two retelling and two touching. The concern recurs across the exploration, container and editor-purpose threads, and the existing statement already covers the first half.

If you agree, the change is made by succession: a successor that supersedes this record, which stays as it is.
